0022600193.text: The Golden State Warriors (6-3) host the Orlando Magic (2-6) on a six-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Pacific one game back and 7th in the West, with a 4-1 home record. Orlando is 0-4 at home, has lost three straight, and is 12th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 2.5 games back. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while Gui Santos is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Warriors won the last meeting 120-97 in San Francisco on December 22, 2025, while this season's series has no games yet.
